code='''def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==1]
    # The repeated 1s define a diagonal line; extend it both ways.
    (r1,c1),(r2,c2)=pts[:2]
    dr=1 if r2>r1 else -1; dc=1 if c2>c1 else -1

    while 0<=r<h and 0<=c<w:
        out[r][c]=1; r-=dr; c-=dc
    r,c=r2+dr,c2+dc
    while 0<=r<h and 0<=c<w:
        out[r][c]=1; r+=dr; c+=dc
    return out
'''
